specialRules.name: Pride of the Southlands
specialRules.text: Friendly models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take.

units.name: Dalamyr, Fleetmaster of Umbar
units.keywords: MAN, CORSAIR, UMBAR, HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Smoke Bombs
specialRules.text: These are throwing weapons with a Strength of 1. Any model hit, but not slain, must immediately expend a Will Point or suffer the effects of Transfix and have their Fight Value halved until the End Phase. If Dalamyr rolls a 1 To Hit his supply has run out.

specialRules.name: Preternatural Agility
specialRules.text: Dalamyr can never count as Trapped whilst still standing.

specialRules.name: Long-bladed Spear
